purpose: Show the progress status verdict (AS, IS, LB, NSA) of each campaign student on the students page, calculated from the passed learning path courses against the cumulative target per week.
acceptance_criteria: The week is counted in 7-day blocks from the campaign open_at and is frozen at close_at; before open_at there is no status.
Target(N) is the number of learning path courses with target_week <= N; more passed than the target is AS, equal is IS, at least target(N-1) is LB, otherwise NSA.
The students table has a Progress column with the status badge and passed/total courses, or - without a learning path or status.
The student progress dialog shows the status badge with the week, target and passed count.

reviews.evidence: Claude Code pr-rules subagent, read pf8/diff.patch (10 source files, bundle skipped), ValueObject, CourseProgress, Campaign, badge variants, frontend-inertia.md; 1 should-fix, 1 question.

findings.evidence: progressStatuses is a data map in .helpers.ts; frontend-inertia.md puts data in {feature}.constants.ts with SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE names.
findings.resolution: Moved the status map to student-list.constants.ts as PROGRESS_STATUSES.

findings.evidence: Action builds the LearningPathProgress VO from gateway data; APD has no read-side UseCase and the action already reads gateways.
findings.resolution: No read-side UseCases exist; read actions build VOs from gateways (Users/Settings/AcademyEditAction::createUserInterest), and this action already does so for CourseProgress.

findings.evidence: toArray() and the action's getter mapping list the same five fields.
findings.resolution: Kept toArray() (required by ValueObject) and getter mapping in the action, like CourseProgress in the same action.

findings.evidence: courseCount duplicates learningPath.courses.length already sent in the same payload.
findings.resolution: Dropped courseCount; the column uses learningPath.courses.length.

findings.evidence: presentLearningPath maps the same course/progress pairs twice.
findings.resolution: LearningPathProgress takes target_weeks and passed_count, so the action maps the courses once.
